entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: An event on Otaria in the Rift Era centered on Ixidor's realm Topos.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Exiled illusionist who created Topos and Akroma.

entities.name: Topos
entities.description: Paradise raised by Ixidor from the sands.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Angelic being forged by Ixidor to take revenge on Phage.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: The woman who killed Nivea, whose wurms caused the cataclysm.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: The woman who resurfaced from Phage's soul and absorbed the nightmares.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Druid, former guardian of the Mirari.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Cruel merchant-priests who ruled through blood and fear.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where the war took place.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Ancient numen whose forgotten magic awakened in Ixidor.

events.summary: Ixidor, exiled to the desert of Otaria, gained Lowallyn's magic and raised Topos.
events.quote: He raised from the sands a paradise he named Topos

events.summary: Ixidor created Akroma to avenge Nivea against Phage.
events.quote: a single purpose: revenge against Phage

events.summary: Akroma led Ixidor's armies against the Cabal, who with Kamahl's Krosans tracked her to Topos.
events.quote: Akroma led Ixidor’s armies against the Cabal

events.summary: Kamahl fought a twisted version of himself in the madness.
events.quote: Kamahl — the druid who had once been the Mirari 's guardian — was forced to battle a twisted version of himself

events.summary: Phage's slain souls became deathwurms that tore rents in reality, creating the Nightmare Lands.
events.quote: The wurms rampaged across Topos, creating the Nightmare Lands

events.summary: A deathwurm born from Nivea's murder devoured Ixidor.
Jeska resurfaced within Phage after the devastation.
events.quote: allowed the woman once known as Jeska to resurface from within Phage’s twisted soul

events.summary: Jeska absorbed all the nightmares into herself with Akroma and Kamahl's aid.
events.quote: Jeska absorbed all the nightmares into herself

events.summary: Kamahl returned to Krosa, Akroma seized Topos's ruins, and the Cabal withdrew.
events.quote: Akroma, bereft of her creator but still alive, seized control of the ruins of Topos.

relations.quote: Akroma , an angelic being forged for a single purpose
the woman who had killed Ixidor's beloved, Nivea
Her hatred for Phage burned undiminished.
Akroma — still bound by Ixidor's final orders
